notes.title: Roller Drama Officially Steam Deck Verified! Plus Clear Texts Update
notes.notes:
For this update, we worked on optimizing readability and font quality rendering, which was sub-optimal for Chinese and Japanese fonts.
Now the latter don't rely on fallbacks for missing characters so the overall experience should be better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/05453e8e1809e6c3b918340f4795f1687e375237.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Roller Drama on the Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
So we set up Roller Drama in order to make it available and running smoothly on the Steam Deck. We first needed to check system compatibility; given that we didn't get a development kit yet, we followed Steamworks documentation [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/steamdeck/testing]Developing for Steam Deck without a Dev-Kit[/url].

For the input, Roller Drama works fine with a controller, so that was fine. For the display, we developed an adaptive system

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/0d0420176e0a1b09b570a3443c76ba4f17b3b8b2.jpg[/img]

so that in the case of a relatively small screen, the main contents are shown larger and with bigger fonts. What if you attach your Steam Deck to a big screen? Just go to settings and turn off the "small screen friendly" option \o/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/37f0553d54bcffa661cf971596128e8a2ea27689.jpg[/img]

For system support, Roller Drama is also released for SteamOS / Linux, so we make our builds run on Steam set on Manjaro as suggested by Valve:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/424d95ba97a646f34439bcbe9875aa90fb279a56.png[/img]

For performance, again from Settings as shown above you can pick the level of graphical quality, though in our tests, even on High Roller Drama actually runs quite well (no pun!).

And so, here you can see Roller Drama running on the Steam Deck:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/f9ca83a36afe5143969d41ea687d7369568ec2f1.jpg[/img]

So we hope you are adding it now to your wishlist, Roller Drama will be released very early 2023!!!

notes.title: New game Roller Drama gives my friends who do roller derby even more ways to do roller derby
notes.notes:
Whomst among us didn't watch Whip It over a decade ago and think about giving full-contact skating sport a go, before falling over on once and deciding to pack it in? I have a bunch of friends who persisted and now spend their weekends in gyms and car parks, where they skate under 11/10 names like Correctional Felicity and give each other huge bruises. I can't be sure, but from their activity on social media I estimate they spend about 114% of their time being excited about roller derby, which I endorse. Now both they (and people like me, who find wheels frightening), can spend even more free time on roller derby with the annoucenment of 2023's sports management game Roller Drama.

Read more

notes.title: A Story With A Hundred Twists
notes.notes:
We’ve been super busy working on the narrative of Roller Drama! A lot of changes and testing have gone into creating a set of both evolving events and comic sitcom; you’ll now be able to make more than 100 meaningful narrative decisions during a playthrough of Roller Drama. We really want to give you a sense of importance and purpose for every action and decision you make. You’ll decide how you roll ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/75687a91226a9065f42178dc4fa5ba4b28164f24.gif[/img]

Both mechanics and narrative are profoundly intertwined in Roller Drama; from chats, solving quests and playing matches, anything that happens will influence outcomes and relationships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/2ce31a147dc5b3c6f7db79ef67ab325a2a53f6aa.jpg[/img]

You’ll now be able to check on your relationships with each member of the team, and follow their evolving self-esteem and personality. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/bb76b9ae09693bf2984d813e94a26ca8b3ec3c95.jpg[/img]

You’ll also be able to see the progression of your decisions (and your “score”!) by checking the in-game achievement list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/dea1e19a1f1766a63a4e7ae983a900fbd74ffa04.jpg[/img]


And, if you’re like us and want to see every aspect of the story, don’t worry! You’ll be able to restart each of the ten chapters separately during play, so you’ll be able to change previous outcomes and explore alternate paths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/fdd51473c17b766e1507a4de47c04ade8b83ebca.jpg[/img]

If you haven’t already, please wishlist our game when you get the chance! It really helps us out more than you know :)

notes.title: The Evolution of Roller Drama's Mechanics
notes.notes:
Roller Drama development is in its final phase, and now we have a gameplay trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yMFdQrT8Zbw
Since 2020 we have kept evolving the game in its narrative and sports mechanics, starting from [b]very rough prototypes[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/ddebc2c51838a515e441872a3fbcce5c32cb1d04.jpg[/img]

Roller Derby like matches went from strategy to real-time to how they are now, [b]a mix of real-time actions and time paused strategy choices:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/d205174318f05ca323e02a458ba70b06ce8e9307.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/fafb657730c9363050bbc16d192b503e9f3ab52f.jpg[/img]

We had a chess-like management of mind states:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/64ebe51ce4b609ab9fa38ce59c4c8fc1f5011390.jpg[/img]

that has been turned into [b]a full immersion in your team's lives and situations that you have to deal with interactively[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/1fd643abe38461f508b1ed748bf52423c0611f53.jpg[/img]

The adventure part[b] mixes comedic and messy life situations that you have to solve[/b] with point-and-click puzzles and interactive fiction with dialogues and interactions filled with choices. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/89fdc4866ee10e582a2f87806a74654c1fc1a696.jpg[/img]

The narrative design too has been evolving, moving from a visual novel style to a more characteristic one.

What is crucial is the interaction between evolving plot and match management; the integration has been thickening in time by creating bridge elements such as "special cards" that can be used in matches and in having a "pep talk" puzzle between "jams" (a three minute period of continuous match play).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/5c5326fc21e645fc6f466b0a95c529484bf5a759.jpg[/img]

About one thing we are quite sure: [b]this is still a unique game![/b] ːsteammockingː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37548544/04ec9a13379c4408fb412bb637be709990bc9b13.gif[/img]
